title: Entomatado de Pollo (Pollo en Salsa de Tomate)
description: Entomatado de Pollo (Pollo en Salsa de Tomate) is a traditional Mexican chicken dish featuring tender bone-in chicken simmered in a rich tomato sauce flavored with garlic, onion, oregano, and cumin. Finished with fresh cilantro and optional crema, it is comforting, flavorful, and perfect with rice or warm tortillas.

ingredients.title: For the Tomato Sauce
items: Ripe Roma tomatoes (or 1½ cups canned crushed tomatoes) – 6
Medium poblano pepper – 1 (optional, for mild heat)
Salt and black pepper – to taste

ingredients.title: For Finishing
items: Mexican crema or heavy cream – ½ cup (optional)
Thinly sliced white onion – ¼ cup (for garnish)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Chicken
steps: Pat chicken dry and season generously with salt and pepper.
In a large skillet or heavy-bottomed pot, heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Brown the chicken on all sides until golden, about 5–7 minutes per side. Remove and set aside.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Make the Tomato Sauce
steps: Boil tomatoes, onion, garlic, and poblano pepper in water for 10 minutes, or until softened.
Transfer vegetables to a blender, add a pinch of salt, and blend until smooth. Strain for a silky texture (optional, for restaurant quality).
In the same skillet, heat 1 tbsp oil over medium heat. Add blended tomato mixture and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add chicken stock, oregano, cumin, bay leaf, and adjust salt and pepper. Bring to a simmer.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Cook the Chicken in the Sauce
steps: Return the browned chicken to the sauce.
Cover and simmer gently over low heat for 25–30 minutes, or until the chicken is fully cooked and tender.
Occasionally spoon sauce over the chicken to keep it moist.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Finish the Dish
steps: Remove bay leaf. Stir in crema for richness, if desired.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro over the chicken.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Serve
steps: Plate the chicken with sauce generously spooned over it.
Garnish with thinly sliced onions and extra cilantro.
Best served with Mexican white rice or warm corn tortillas.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with Mexican white rice or warm corn tortillas.
Pair with refried beans and a fresh green salad.
Garnish with extra cilantro and a drizzle of Mexican crema before serving.

chefTips: Tomatoes: Roasting the tomatoes before blending adds a smoky depth.
Chicken: Bone-in chicken ensures more flavor; remove skin for a cleaner presentation.
Sauce: Straining the sauce is optional but gives a restaurant-level smoothness.
Garnish: A drizzle of crema and a sprig of cilantro elevates the visual appeal.
